commit_message:
avformat/hlsenc: Respect `append_list` flag in subtitle

Ensure that when the `-hls_flags append_list` option is set,
that *.vtt files in stream_vtt.m3u8 are correctly updated.
This fixes https://trac.ffmpeg.org/ticket/11208

Reviewed-by: Steven Liu <lq@chinaffmpeg.org>

fix_commit_message:
avformat/hlsenc: fix format string vulnerability in parse_playlist

Found-by: Sarthak Munshi <sarthakmunshi@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 65fc0db581c4 on top of intro 425c3234206c via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError): libavformat/hlsenc.c's parse_playlist() function, when handling the `append_list` HLS flag for subtitle segments, calls `snprintf(vtt_file, len, vtt_basename, vtt_index)` where `vtt_basename` (derived from the configurable VTT/subtitle filename template) is used directly as the *format string* rather than as literal data. Because this filename-derived string is attacker/user influenced and can contain unexpected `%` conversion specifiers, this is an uncontrolled/user-controlled format string vulnerability that can cause crashes, out-of-bounds reads/information disclosure, or worse. Root cause: The code assumes that the VTT basename always contains a well-formed, single `%d`-style placeholder intended for the segment index and unconditionally forwards that string as the fmt argument of snprintf(), rather than treating the basename as opaque data and only substituting the index through a controlled, format-string-free mechanism.
